faqs.question: Can multiple users print to the same printer?
faqs.answer: Yes. We set up network or Wi-Fi printing so everyone in the office can print and scan from their own computer.

faqs.question: Do you help reduce printing costs?
faqs.answer: We recommend models with a lower cost per page for your print volume, which often saves more than a cheaper upfront price.

faqs.question: Can scanned documents go straight to email or a shared folder?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can configure scan-to-email and scan-to-folder on supported devices.
